title: On Riding the grey mare to market
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：ride　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ride 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the elder ① rode the grey mare to market in silence, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② rides the grey mare to market twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ ride the grey mare to market at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ ridden the grey mare to market before — a line in the memoir for November 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Riding the grey mare to market in silence, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ ride on the hay cart to the fields twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Ride on the hay cart to the fields at once and never mention it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ rides on the hay cart to the fields in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ rode the grey mare to market again when nobody else would.

⑩ To ride the grey mare to market, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody rides the grey mare to market twice over again and somebody must ride the grey mare to market in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 骑（一般过去式 rode the grey mare to market：1950 年长者头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 骑（一般现在 rides the grey mare to market：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 骑（不定式 to ride the grey mare to market：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 骑（过去完成时 had ridden the grey mare to market：1944 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 骑（动名词 riding the grey mare to market 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 乘（ride on the hay cart to the fields：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去乘搭运草的车去地里）
G. v. 乘（ride on the hay cart to the fields：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 骑（后段两处：新来的后生照例 rides on the hay cart to the fields，而母亲又一次 rode the grey mare to market）

answers.why: ride 意为“骑”，1950 年长者一言不发地骑骑那匹灰马去赶集，那是村子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 rode。
ride 意为“骑”，自那以后长者来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 rides。
ride 意为“骑”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯骑骑那匹灰马去赶集”，此处为不定式 to ride the grey mare to market。
ride 意为“骑”，回忆录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人骑过，故用过去完成时 had ridden。
ride 意为“骑”，长者说“骑骑那匹灰马去赶集这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 riding the grey mare to market 作主语。
ride 意为“乘”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去乘搭运草的车去地里”，should ever 之后用原形 ride on the hay cart to the fields。
ride 意为“乘”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻乘搭运草的车去地里（ride on the hay cart to the fields at once），以后再也不要提起。
ride 意为“骑”，新来的后生每个年头都照例乘搭运草的车去地里，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 rides。
ride 意为“骑”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地骑骑那匹灰马去赶集，用一般过去式 rode 叙述。
ride 意为“骑”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要骑骑那匹灰马去赶集，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和村子记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，长者一言不发地骑骑那匹灰马去赶集；村子里每一个后生都说这是头一回。（rode the grey mare to market）
多年以后，长者仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（rides the grey mare to market）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯骑骑那匹灰马去赶集这件事本身。（to ride the grey mare to market）
早在 1944 年就有人骑骑那匹灰马去赶集，十一月那天回忆录上的一行字就是证据。（had ridden the grey mare to market）
长者说过，一言不发地骑骑那匹灰马去赶集这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（riding the grey mare to market 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻乘搭运草的车去地里，以后再也不要提起。（ride on the hay cart to the fields，祈使句）

Three years on, the elder still rides the grey mare to market twice over without being asked.

Somebody had ridden the grey mare to market long before 1957, and the line in the memoir for November proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ride 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the elder rode the grey mare to market in silence, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder rides the grey mare to market twice over whenever the village asks.
Riding the grey mare to market in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever ride on the hay cart to the fields twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village rides on the hay cart to the fields in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother rode the grey mare to market again, and the village remembered that half.
